name: Survey tile in Leo
blurb: A 0.3 degree patch 0.4 degrees south of the ecliptic in Leo, imaged by SPHEREx 12 times in 3 visits over 28 hours. Picked automatically by the survey because it was imaged often enough to follow a moving object.
summary_plain: 26 SPHEREx images of this patch taken over 34 hours starting 2025-04-28, at wavelengths from 1.64 to 4.99 µm. The pipeline found 1 moving object.
